## `joustmania.controller_manager.ControllerManagerService` (`proto/controller_manager.proto`, 6 RPCs)

| RPC | Kind | Request → Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `StreamButtonEvents` | bidi stream | `ButtonEventStreamControl` → `ButtonEvent` | Button press / release events to the client; the client sends base LED colours and effects back. Not browser-reachable, connect-proxy does not forward it (#1543) |
| `StreamGameplayData` | bidi stream | `GameplayStreamControl` → `GameplayDataUpdate` | Motion data at the requested rate, with each controller's connection quality on the unfiltered (dashboard) stream (`GameplayData.connection_quality`: class and p95 / longest report gap, UC-035 BR-005; game streams leave it unset); an observer stream (one that never sent colours) runs at its requested rate capped at `game_loop.update_frequency_hz` and never drains disconnects, health counters or the mock death latch (UC-035 BR-006); the client changes filters, colours and effects mid-stream. Not forwarded by connect-proxy (#1543); the browser uses `WatchGameplayData` |
| `RenameController` | unary | `RenameControllerRequest` → `RenameControllerResponse` | Rename a controller (set custom human-readable name) |
| `GetConnectedControllers` | unary | `GetConnectedControllersRequest` → `GetConnectedControllersResponse` | Query the controller manager's authoritative live roster on demand (#1153). Unlike the event-piggybacked connected_serials (only refreshed on the next CONNECT/DISCONNECT), this returns the current connected set synchronously so a client (the menu) can reconcile ghosts after a missed disconnect. Also read by `scripts/talk-preflight.sh` through envoy to count real controllers (UC-070 BR-006). |
| `IdentifyController` | unary | `IdentifyControllerRequest` → `IdentifyControllerResponse` | Request → response: `IdentifyControllerRequest` (`serial`, `duration_ms`: 0 = 3000 ms, clamped to 500..10000) → `IdentifyControllerResponse` (`success`, `outcome`: `started` / `not_connected` / `in_game` / `reserved` / `invalid`, `error`, `duration_ms`: the duration used). Flash a controller white at 2 Hz and rumble it briefly, then restore its colour, so the operator can find it; refused for controllers that are not connected, reserved, or players of an open game gameplay stream, and cancelled when a game stream claims the controller (UC-004, FR-121) |
| `WatchGameplayData` | server stream | `GameplayStreamConfig` → `GameplayDataUpdate` | Browser view of `StreamGameplayData` (#1595): one `GameplayStreamConfig` in (the dashboard sends `{updateFrequencyHz: 30}`), the `GameplayDataUpdate`s out. Served by connect-proxy only: it opens an unfiltered (observer) `StreamGameplayData` stream to the controller manager with only the rate (missing or 0 and below = 30 Hz, capped at 30 Hz; never colours), relays every update and closes that stream when the browser goes away; an upstream error ends the browser stream with it. The controller manager itself answers UNIMPLEMENTED (UC-035 MSS) |

## `joustmania.game_coordinator.GameCoordinatorService` (`proto/game_coordinator.proto`, 4 RPCs)

| RPC | Kind | Request → Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ForceEndGame` | unary | `ForceEndGameRequest` → `ForceEndGameResponse` | Force end current game |
| `StreamGameEvents` | server stream | `StreamEventsRequest` → `GameEvent` | Stream game events (deaths, scoring, etc.) If start_config is provided, starts a new game and streams every event of that game, beginning with game_start (which carries the game_id), then game_starting, game_started, and so on. The starter is subscribed to the new session's bus before game_start is published and before the game thread starts (#1783). A failed start yields one game_start_error event, then the stream closes, with no subscriber left behind. If start_config is empty, subscribes to current/upcoming game events; with game_id set, to that game's events from the moment of attaching (observers get no replay). The server sends the response headers (empty initial metadata) as soon as the subscriber is registered on the event bus, before the first event; after `initial_metadata()` every later event is queued for this subscriber (bounded queue, drops on overflow). The start_config and unknown game_id error paths send no early headers, they arrive with the error event. Direct gRPC clients only, the connect-proxy does not forward the early headers (#1613). |
| `GetGameState` | unary | `GetGameStateRequest` → `GetGameStateResponse` | Get current game state (for testing/observability) |
| `ListGames` | unary | `ListGamesRequest` → `ListGamesResponse` | List all live game sessions (primary + shadow). Lets agents and tests enumerate concurrent games and learn their game_ids; the dashboard uses it to pick the shadow game it follows (UC-070 BR-005). |
